title: p0157
universal_lens: Spatial cognition operates as a constrained optimization over sensory manifolds. The transition from holistic intuition to sequential construction introduces temporal discretization errors, fundamentally bounding the precision of spatial ordering when the perceptual field exceeds instantaneous cognitive capacity.
gsi_mapping: GSI models spatial perception as a hierarchical Bayesian filter. When local sensory inputs exceed the prior's receptive field, the system shifts from direct posterior inference to a Markovian sequential update, accumulating epistemic uncertainty across disjointed observational windows.
gse_mapping: In GSE, situational awareness transitions from an intuitive global state vector to a constructed trajectory when environmental complexity spikes. This forces discrete state-transitions, where predictive control relies on chaining localized sub-goals rather than a unified terminal objective.

primitives.name: Holistic Intuition Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: 147 of each other and in definite order they must appear as parts in a vaster sensible extent which can enter the mind simply and all at onœ.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: S: Sensory manifold (dimensionless), O: Ordered subset (dimensionless), U: Unified perceptual unit (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: The sensory manifold S is locally compact and admits a finite partition that fits within the instantaneous cognitive buffer U.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when the cardinality or topological complexity of S exceeds the bounded rationality limit of U, forcing fragmentation.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to the GSE Global State Vector initialization, where the entire pitch topology is ingested as a single coherent tensor before dynamic perturbations occur.
layer2.telemetry: Cognitive load index; measured by initial saccade velocity and fixation duration upon entering a new visual field.

primitives.name: Temporal Succession Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: When conscious of our head we tend to grow unconscious of our feet, and there enters thus an element of time-succession into our perception of ourselves which transforms the latter from an act of intuition to one of construction.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: t: Discrete time step (s), C_t: Consciousness focus at t (dimensionless), H/F: Head/Feet spatial loci (m)
primitives.assumptions: Attentional resources are strictly zero-sum; focusing on locus A necessitates the decay of activation at locus B.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails under high-frequency perturbation where the dwell time required for stable perception at locus A is shorter than the neural integration time.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to the GSI sliding window attention mechanism, where the model sequentially attends to disjointed regions of the pitch, stitching together a fragmented posterior distribution.
layer2.telemetry: Head-tracking angular velocity and gaze-switching latency between opposing ends of the field.

primitives.name: Spatial Discrimination Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: That a sensation be discriminated as a part from out of a larger enveloping space is then the conditio sine quî non of its being apprehended in a definite spatial order.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: x: Localized sensation (m^3), E: Enveloping space (m^3), D: Discrimination threshold (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: A contrast gradient exists between x and E sufficient to trigger a boundary detection operator.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs when the signal-to-noise ratio drops below D, causing the localized sensation to dissolve back into the background noise of E.

layer2.mapping: Corresponds to the GSE feature extraction layer, isolating individual player vectors from the dense background noise of the stadium environment.
layer2.telemetry: Contrast sensitivity function metrics and edge-detection activation rates in computer vision pipelines.

reasoning_traces.think:
The derivation begins with the assumption of a continuous sensory manifold representing physical space. Under ideal conditions, this manifold is perceived via the Holistic Intuition Operator, mapping the entirety of the space into a unified cognitive tensor. However, biological and computational constraints impose a strict upper bound on the dimensionality of this tensor. When the spatial extent exceeds this bound, the system cannot maintain a simultaneous representation of all coordinates. Consequently, the Temporal Succession Operator activates, introducing a discrete time variable to slice the spatial manifold into sequential cross-sections. This transformation converts a static geometric problem into a dynamic, Markovian process. The Spatial Discrimination Kernel acts as the boundary condition for these slices, extracting localized features from the enveloping background. The fundamental duality lies between the lossless, instantaneous intuition and the lossy, cumulative construction. The failure mode emerges during the stitching phase: because each temporal slice is processed independently, the relative phase and magnitude between distant points (e.g., head vs. feet) suffer from integration drift. This drift manifests as the 'vagueness' noted in macroscopic spatial reasoning, mathematically equivalent to the accumulation of numerical error in a long-chain iterative solver. Thus, spatial ordering is not a primitive given, but a computationally expensive reconstruction subject to sequential bottlenecks.
